simple.meaning: צוּץ (tsûwts) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to twinkle , i.e. glance ; by analogy, to blossom (figuratively, flourish ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 9 times across Numbers, Psalms, Song of Solomon, Isaiah, Ezekiel, beginning at Numbers 17:23. Its contexts include land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צוּץ (H6692).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: צוּץ (tsûwts) / H6692 is traced through Numbers 17:23, Psalms 72:16, Psalms 90:6, Psalms 92:8 as a generated source-based concept entry.

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land.

timeline.evidenceText: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land.
In the morning it sprouts and springs up.
But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.
As for man, his days are like grass.
I will clothe his enemies with shame,
In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
“ ‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.

definitions.full: H6692. tsuwts I. [ צִיץ צוּץ, ] verb 1. blossom . 2 shine, sparkle (perhaps original meaning of √, but connection of 1, 2. dubious) (Late Hebrew id. Hiph`il, figurative senses, צִיץ noun = Biblical Hebrew); — Qal Perfect 1 3masculine singular הַמַּטֶּה צָץ Ezek 7:10 (figurative; || הַזָּדוֺן מָּרַח ); Imperfect 3masculine singular יָצִיץ Psa 90:6 (of grass, חָצִיר ), 103:15 (man under figure of flower), figurative יִשׂ וּפָרַח ׳יָצִיץ Isa 27:6 ; 3 masculine plural יָצִיצוּ Psa 72:16 , וַיָּצִיצוּ 92:8 (|| מָּרַח ; both figurative of men =) flourish. 2 shine, gleam: of crown ( נֵזֶר ) Psa 132:18 . Hiph`il Imperfect 3masculine singular צִיץ וַיָּצֵץ Numbers 17:23 it put forth blossoms (of rod; ֵ֯ perhaps from || פֶרַח וַיֹּצֵא ). II. [ צוּץ ] verb Hiph`il gaze, peep (Late Hebrew Hiph`il gaze (rare); Aramaic צִיץ gaze ); — Participle מִןהַֿחֲרַכִּים מֵצִיץ Song 2:9 (see ׳ח , p. 355).
